title.en: Buying on margin and capital surplus

summary.zh-TW: 認識股東權益裡的資本公積從哪裡來、依現行規定能怎麼用，再看投資人「融資」買股票的機制：借錢、擔保品、維持率與追繳，以及這些事為什麼不會出現在公司的帳上。本章只出觀念題，是會計觀念練習，不是投資建議。
summary.en: Learn where capital surplus in equity comes from and how current rules allow it to be used, then look at how investors buy shares on margin: the loan, the collateral, the maintenance ratio and margin calls, and why none of this appears in the company’s books. This chapter has concept questions only; it is an accounting concept exercise, not investment advice.
